artworks.title: Humphrey's Ledge
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Monica and Hermen Greenberg Foundation in honor of Monica Lind Greenberg
artworks.description: The image features a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. It shows a serene expanse of land with mountains in the distance. The horizon line is in the lower third, with a range of mountains stretching across. The left side displays layers of progressively higher peaks, while the right side has a steep, rugged slope covered in dark vegetation. The brushstrokes are loose and impressionistic, with broad strokes for the sky and detailed brushwork for trees and mountains. The color palette is primarily greens and blues, with brighter greens near us transitioning to deeper hues in distant mountains and the cloudy sky. Scattered trees and patches of sunlight provide warmth amidst the cool tones of the scene.

artworks.title: Gossip on the Beach
artworks.description: This grayscale photograph shows a group of women and children on a pebbly beach. There are several woven fishing baskets around them. The women are seated or leaning against the baskets, wearing long, dark dresses with shawls around their shoulders and heads. Some children or young girls lean against the baskets or sit by the women. One woman is pointing towards the sea and appears to be speaking, and the rest of the group is looking towards her. The background features the ocean stretching out to the horizon, with sunlight glistening on the water. A solitary sailboat is visible far off in the distance.

artworks.title: A Sculpture of Moses
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over traces of black chalk on laid paper, pricked for transfer
artworks.description: The image depicts a bearded figure standing. The figure has curly hair and a long beard, and is dressed in classical clothing with a staff in their right hand resting on a rectangular slab. Their left hand is on the slab, and they stand on a decorative pedestal, with a plain background.

artworks.title: Head of a Young Woman Facing Left
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder, after François Boucher
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in black, red, and blue on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a profile view of a person's head and neck, highlighting their facial features such as a nose, lips, and chin. The person has wavy hair styled in an updo with curls falling around the ear. The facial expression appears serene with the eye looking upwards. The lighting creates soft highlights on the face and hair. The background is a light blue color with a decorative border framing the image.

artworks.title: Woman Feeding Chickens
artworks.artist: Gilles-Antoine Demarteau after Jean-Baptiste Hüet, I
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red and black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a three-quarter view, seated and facing slightly to the left. She is depicted from the thighs up, with one leg slightly extended and resting her arm on a basket. She has an upturned face, delicate features, curly hair tied back, and some tendrils framing her face. She wears a flowing garment with a fitted bodice, full sleeves, and soft lines suggesting a fluid texture. A dog stands by her side and there are several chickens, including a rooster, in the foreground. The background features loosely sketched trees or foliage, creating a sense of depth and natural environment.

artworks.title: Woman and Child before a Fireplace
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red and black on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 22.5 x 16.6 cm (8 7/8 x 6 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman and a child seated together. The woman is sitting on a wooden chair with her arm around the child, whose head is leaning against her. The woman has styled hair in an updo and wears a long dress, while the child wears a similarly colored dress. A small dog is sleeping on the floor next to the woman's feet. The background indicates an interior setting with household objects.

artworks.title: Head of a Young Woman Wearing a Hat
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau the Elder after Antoine Watteau
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in black and red on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 24.5 × 16.8 cm (9 5/8 × 6 5/8 in.), cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a woman's body in a portrait orientation. She is positioned slightly turned to her left, with her head tilted downwards. The woman has delicate facial features, with finely drawn eyebrows and lips. Her hair is styled up and adorned with a fabric bow, and she wears a hat with a wide brim. She is dressed in a garment that covers her shoulders and partially exposes her neckline. The background is a plain, textured surface, emphasizing the figure, and the image is bordered as part of the artwork.

artworks.title: Jacob Persuaded to Send Benjamin with His Brethren into Egypt
artworks.artist: William Wynne Ryland, after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.medium: stipple etching and roulette on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures surrounding a central figure with their hands raised. The composition includes multiple figures in close proximity, depicted in an expressive and dynamic style. The central figure is reclined, with the surrounding figures leaning in towards this focal point. The use of bold lines and contrasting shades creates a sense of depth and drama.

artworks.title: La Fontaine de l'Amour
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate (cut within platemark on right): 40.2 x 29.6 cm (15 13/16 x 11 5/8 in.)
sheet: 47.4 x 31.6 cm (18 11/16 x 12 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene featuring a group of elegantly dressed individuals lounging in a lush, natural setting with architectural elements in the background. The etching showcases detailed line work characteristic of etching techniques, providing texture and depth. Close to us, the figures are engaged in leisure activities, while additional figures are seated on a stone structure and cherubic figures are featured on a fountain. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown to create a historical and romantic atmosphere.

artworks.title: La Fontaine de l'Amour
artworks.dimensions:
image (cut within platemark): 36.2 x 27.4 cm (14 1/4 x 10 13/16 in.)
sheet: 40 x 30 cm (15 3/4 x 11 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a fountain and cherubs. The image features an elaborate stone fountain adorned with two cherubs perched atop. The fountain's arch spills water into a small pool below. Around the fountain, intricate foliage creates depth and seclusion, with trees and shrubs enveloping the scene. In the foreground, a group of sheep adds to the pastoral ambiance. Elegantly dressed individuals are seen lounging and engaging at the fountain's side. The composition's detailed lines and soft tones contribute to a refined and harmonious atmosphere.

artworks.title: Sun-Drenched Hills near Menton
artworks.medium: watercolor with scratching out over traces of graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Diane Allen Nixon
artworks.description: The painting depicts a hillside village viewed from an elevated perspective. The horizon is high in the image, with the village atop the hill, individual buildings distinguishable by warm color tones. Behind the village, the sky is clear blue, the mountains fading into darker tones. Delicate, fluid brushstrokes are used, especially in the foliage and winding path. The color palette is earthy and natural, with greens and browns predominant, the village's architecture and vibrant greenery offering lighter contrasts. The landscape shows rolling terrain rising towards the top of the hill.

artworks.title: The Portal of the Madonna della Misericordia from the Canal
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a historical architectural structure with a sculptural archway on a clear day. The view is a straight-on perspective looking towards the ornate entrance of the building. The scene is framed by the building's walls and the blue sky with some clouds. The brushstrokes show detailed textures of the stone and sculptures, with warm earth tones dominating the color palette. There are hints of greenery visible through the archway, suggesting a garden beyond. The water nearby reflects blue and dark green hues. Light and shadow are artistically depicted.

artworks.title: Perseus and Andromeda
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a chained figure in a rocky landscape near the sea. The image shows a group of figures gathered around a rocky outcrop. To the right, a nude figure is chained to the rock and looking into the distance, while another group of onlookers is on the left side. In the background, there are cliffs and water, with a mythical creature emerging from the sea. Above, a mounted figure is approaching the scene. The drawing includes detailed expressions and costumes, creating a narrative composition full of tension and drama. The line work and shading show skill in draftsmanship.

artworks.title: Fantasy of an Antique Temple
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior with a grand staircase. It shows rich classical architectural elements in detail, with an arched entrance leading to the staircase. The stairs go up to a row of ornate columns and arches on the upper level. Decorative urns, sculptures, and a statue bust decorate the space. Elaborate moldings and details cover the surfaces, creating a lavish atmosphere. The drawing emphasizes depth and perspective, inviting viewers to explore the complex spatial composition.

artworks.title: A Meadow with Cattle at the Edge of a Wood
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a meadow, trees, cows, and figures. The scene is depicted with fine lines and delicate hatching, creating textures throughout. The color palette is primarily black and white, creating a classic and serene visual impact.

artworks.title: Three Riders before an Inn
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two horses with riders in a countryside setting. The image shows two horses with riders, detailed line work, and background elements such as figures and foliage.

artworks.title: Heroic Landscape with Cart and Goatherd, with San Giorgio Maggiore in the Background
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson after Marco Ricci
artworks.description: The image portrays an elevated perspective overlooking a pastoral landscape with a grand building on the right side. The horizon is placed low, showcasing mountains and distant structures. The painting technique uses detailed brushstrokes for trees and texture, varying density for depth. The color palette consists of muted greens, browns, blues, with hints of red and cream. Figures are depicted, including a person with a walking stick and another leading animals, adding life. An expansive field, trees, and a large building with a dome and spire are visible, framed by lush foliage, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: David with the Head of Goliath
artworks.artist: Attributed to Pierre Mignard I after Simon Vouet
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Alan Stone and Lesley Hill
artworks.description: The image shows a person in an upper-body view, standing or leaning to the side with their torso exposed. The individual has a defined upper body with curly, shoulder-length hair. Their facial expression is serious, and they are looking slightly to the right. The person is wrapped in a draped cloth that covers one shoulder and a part of their lower torso. They are holding an elaborately designed sword in one hand, resting against their body in a relaxed manner. The background displays detailed foliage, a large tree trunk, and lush leaves encircling the figure. The scene is depicted in a classical style with intricate etching details.

artworks.title: The Calumny of Apelles
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of classical figures in an architectural setting. The figures are dressed in classical attire and engaged in various interactions. In the center, a seated figure appears authoritative, with the surrounding figures attentive. To the left, a statue of a standing figure is positioned within an archway. Above, a dark sky reveals a celestial presence. An inscription in Latin is displayed on a tablet at the base. The drawing is precise and detailed, similar to Renaissance or Baroque works.

artworks.title: Le Pont Neuf
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a bridge spanning across a river, reflecting buildings in the water. Small boats are tied to the river's edge, with people visible. The artwork is done using an etching technique with detailed line work, creating texture and depth. The color scheme is mainly sepia tones with darker shades for contrast. Swirling clouds in the background add a sense of motion to the skyline.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.artist: Pierre Brebiette after Andrea del Sarto
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 22.8 x 17.9 cm (9 x 7 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals and a baby, all visible from the torso up, with the baby fully shown. The first figure, an older male, is positioned slightly behind the others, his head bowed and resting on his arms, with long hair and a beard visible. The second figure, a woman, is seated with her body turned towards the child, head slightly inclined with long hair falling behind her back. She is wearing draped garments with many folds. The third figure, a standing child, has curly, short hair and is lightly shading its eyes with one hand. The baby, seated on the ground, is depicted with a soft expression, looking upwards with its head and body angled slightly towards the woman. All figures are surrounded by drapery textures and folds. In the background, simple architectural elements suggest a stone structure, and the ground beneath them appears uneven and natural.

artworks.title: The Cup of Tea (La tasse de thé)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint with monoprint inking on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a person's upper body in profile view, seated and facing slightly to the right. The person's facial features are obscured by shadows, but their nose and mouth are visible. They are wearing dark clothing and a hat, and holding a small object in one hand. The background has a blurred, abstract pattern with vertical and diagonal lines.

artworks.title: The River God Nile
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 33 x 55.1 cm (13 x 21 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a reclining bearded figure surrounded by small cherubic figures and decorative elements. A large, muscular male figure with a laurel wreath lies horizontally across the lower portion of the image, exuding a classical, mythological presence reminiscent of river gods from ancient cultures. His body is positioned on what appears to be flowing water, surrounded by numerous small, infant-like figures engaged in playful activities and bearing symbols. To the right of the prominent figure, one cherubic child is holding a cornucopia, brimming with fruits and flowers. The area around the central figure incorporates intricate relief bordering the edges of the drawing, embellished with animals and ornate, vine-like scrollwork. The top section contains an inset of Latin text. The meticulous stippling and hatching techniques contribute to the texture and depth, rendering the drawing a marvel of classical revival style consistent with engravings from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Landscape with Two Deer
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a horizon in the distance, small trees, and a possible structure. A large, gnarled tree with intricate foliage is in the foreground. Small figures on horseback are to the left, leading a group along a path that disappears into the landscape. The style uses cross-hatching and detailed strokes for texture. The color palette is monochrome with earthy tones, creating contrast and highlights.
